title: Orbital Gardens: Narrative Mystery

foundation.history: The ring garden habitat was built to protect hydroponic nutrients, but life-support imbalance interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Tavi Oriel, a investigator, must reconstruct an erased civic record using evidence synthesis while life-support imbalance threatens the ring garden habitat.
central_conflict: a record-forging council seeks control of hydroponic nutrients; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: life-support imbalance isolates the ring garden habitat
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a record-forging council offers privileged access to hydroponic nutrients
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
